build_svhn_dataset_builder: build a TensorFlow Dataset builder for the cropped SVHN digit recognition dataset with train, test, and extra splits
create_svhn_dataset_info: create dataset metadata with image features, class labels, and optional record IDs for the SVHN cropped dataset
generate_svhn_examples: generate examples from MATLAB .mat files by extracting 32x32 images and digit labels for each split
split_svhn_dataset: split the SVHN dataset into train, test, and extra splits by downloading and processing MATLAB data files
review_svhn_builder_class: review the GeneratorBasedBuilder class that downloads, splits, and yields SVHN cropped image-label pairs
